tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and table cell text on bg-container and bg-container-grey. 15:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: Row titles in tables and lists, form labels: SemiBold, a step off black. 10:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta, second lines, batch columns, field hints, done step labels. 7.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Column labels, counts, placeholders, upcoming steps, quiet dates. 4.8:1 on white: the lightest grey allowed for text.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text only (exempt from contrast); never for readable content.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links or words that carry the brand action; 4.5:1 on white. Prefer text-primary + underline for ordinary links.

tokens.name: text-white
tokens.usage: Text on brand-6 (btn-primary) and other dark fills.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.usage: Field error messages and danger text on white or status-danger-bg.

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text on white or status-warning-bg.

tokens.name: border-dark
tokens.usage: Card, input, table and secondary-button borders. Decided 20 Oct: the one border for containers and controls.

tokens.name: border-light
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card: between table rows, under card headers.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Border of the Accent tag and the Your action pill.

tokens.name: border-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Border of the now display Chip: a step darker than bg-accent so the chip holds its edge.

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: Active nav underline and the brand focus ring on primary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-container-grey
tokens.usage: Page background, table row hover, disabled inputs, Received needs panels.

tokens.name: bg-accent
tokens.usage: Accent tag and Your action pill background.

tokens.name: btn-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: one per screen or panel, for the action that moves the work on. White text 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover; Accent tag and Your action pill text (5.9:1 on bg-accent).

tokens.name: icon-dark
tokens.usage: Default icon colour (every icon is drawn in it).

tokens.name: icon-default
tokens.usage: Muted icons: search glass in inputs, quiet meta icons.

tokens.name: icon-active
tokens.usage: The rare icon that marks something needing the customer.

tokens.name: icon-white
tokens.usage: Icons on dark or brand fills.

tokens.name: status-danger-mark
tokens.usage: Danger dots, icons and the error input border (3:1 is enough for marks).

tokens.name: status-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger tag text on status-danger-bg; passes 4.5:1. Status is never a solid fill.

tokens.name: status-warning-mark
tokens.usage: Warning dots, icons and the error input border (3:1 is enough for marks).

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning tag text on status-warning-bg; passes 4.5:1. Status is never a solid fill.

tokens.name: status-success-mark
tokens.usage: Success dots, icons and the error input border (3:1 is enough for marks).

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Success tag text on status-success-bg; passes 4.5:1. Status is never a solid fill.

tokens.name: status-info-mark
tokens.usage: Info dots, icons and the error input border (3:1 is enough for marks).

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: Info tag text on status-info-bg; passes 4.5:1. Status is never a solid fill.

tokens.name: black-2
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light dividers, halos on the current step.

tokens.name: black-4
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dashed border of later display chips, done step dots, hollow marks (fails 4.5:1: never text).

tokens.name: black-7
tokens.usage: Primitive. Ink: text-primary, current steps, checked boxes.

tokens.name: brand-6
tokens.usage: Primitive. The CQuel orange (decided 20 Oct): 4.5:1 with white. Means "this needs you".

tokens.name: amber-6
tokens.usage: Primitive. Legacy marketplace highlight; not for text (1.8:1).

tokens.name: blue-6
tokens.usage: Primitive. Legacy link blue; blue is now only for information.

tokens.name: green-1
tokens.usage: Legacy primitive from the green-brand era; marketplace screens only.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Key figures (KeyFigure Big): one number that is the point of the block. Tabular figures.

styles.name: h8
styles.usage: Emphasis: table row titles, details values, form labels, buttons.

styles.name: p7
styles.usage: Meta, second lines, hints, key dates.

styles.name: s3
styles.usage: Column labels and card labels, in capitals with 4% tracking, text-tertiary.

spacing.note: Figma Distance tokens. Off-scale values snap to the nearest step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a value and its second line in small blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dot or icon → label inside pills, tabs and keys.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Button group gap, icon → text, table cell top/bottom.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card header padding, field spacing, check card padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, table cell sides, between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page side padding; table first-column left padding (room for the changed dot).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, check cards, needs panels.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Photos (the asset page site photo) and the Overview hero search.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, step dots, phase circles.

shadow.note: Cards sit flat with a border; only floating things cast a shadow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus everywhere: a soft 4px ink halo, no line (Olena, 6 Nov). Fields also turn their border black-6. Never orange, never on mouse click (:focus-visible only).

tokens.name: halo-current
tokens.usage: The current step dot and delivery phase circle.

iconSize.note: Icons are drawn on a 24 grid and scale.
